g05-platform-7.observed_description: A plain dark-green train with open doors waits at a long platform under an arched glass roof; a big square dark-blue sign with a white 7 hangs at the upper left.
g05-platform-7.note: Usable at 3:2: platform seven reads at 180 px and the train has no markings; the 7 sits outside the centered 4:5 crop, so it is never in a four-picture card.
